title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(小暮潔研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Kogure Kiyoshi)
keywords: Robot mechanics and mechatronics 2.Robot intelligence 3.Measurement and control 4.Robot programming 5.Regional collaboration and Social Implementation
educationalGoal: (1) Acquire the ability to find and solve problems to research, develop, design, and create new robotic systems, using the basic knowledge and skills you learned in other Department of Robotics courses. (2) Learn what technologies are required to solve problems. (3) Learn about the importance of collaboration with society (particularly local communities) and social implementation.
advice: This is the final comprehensive course in the Department of Robotics. It is a two-semester course. For the realization of the educational objectives in the Department of Robotics, this course focuses on the following topics: (1) Students will acquire the ability to create new robotic systems integrated mechanics, measurement and control engineering, electronics, and programming techniques. (2) Students will acquire the ability and the engineering sense to propose optimal solutions through design projects. Students should reconfirm their project theme, which has been determined in a preparatory seminar with the supervisors of the individual laboratories.
requiredKnowledge: Have the skills and knowledge required for carrying out a project at each laboratory. Obtain a license for using machine tools at YUMEKOBO.

activityGoals.body: Advance your project in according to the engineering design process.
Compile the results correctly into a report and discuss the content through presentations.
Act independently to solve the issues presented separately.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要
